entities.name: Fidan Doğan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fidan Doğan was a Kurdish activist who worked at the Kurdish information centre in Paris and also represented the Brussels-based Kurdish National Congress in France. She was assassinated in Paris on 10 January 2013, along with Sakine Cansız and Leyla Şöylemez.
